findings.passage: Wisconsin’s families deserve to feel safe in their communities. I am proud to support this legislation as these measures are not about restricting freedom, but ensuring that those who wish to own a firearm are doing so responsibly and with consideration for their own safety and that of their fellow citizens. We can find common-sense solutions to reduce gun violence while respecting the rights of law-abiding citizens
findings.note: His quoted statement in a press release he issued (posted on Urban Milwaukee) on introducing the safe summer bill package; the page's own text is reproduced as printed, and the page text ends this sentence without a full stop.
subjects: general statement on gun safety laws and gun rights

findings.passage: Protecting people’s safety, without overriding their freedom, is a goal we can all support. Together, we can build a Wisconsin that is safer for everyone, while upholding the rights provided to us by our founders.
findings.note: Closing lines of the same press release statement from him.
subjects: general statement on gun safety laws and gun rights

findings.passage: He cosponsored two bills; one would establish universal background checks for all gun sales, ensuring that individuals with a history of concerning behavior would not be able to purchase firearms and the other implements a 48-hour waiting period for those purchasing firearms, providing a necessary period to allow purchasers to make rational, informed decisions.
findings.note: Sentence in his own press release (issued in his name, written in the third person) saying he cosponsored a universal background check bill and a 48-hour waiting period bill. The release gives no bill numbers.

findings.passage: My campaign has received the candidate distinction from Moms Demand Action Gun Sense.
